summary: Through-road kerb with no stopping signs, painted median and no parked cars.
reasons: Main road, nobody parks at this kerb
Narrow grass edge, no room off lane

drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane through road beside a campus.
drivers.convention: No cars park at this kerb; two No Stopping Any Time signs within 9 m.
